headline: Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority: Vessels will face restrictions on future passage, including fines, detention, or confiscation

predictions.mechanism: Tighter Hormuz passage risk raises oil/inflation risk and weighs on risk assets.
predictions.invalidation: Restrictions prove non-binding and oil/risk premium falls quickly.

predictions.mechanism: Oil-led inflation and high yields pressure long-duration growth equities.
predictions.invalidation: Oil and yields retreat materially and risk appetite stabilizes.

predictions.mechanism: Europe is sensitive to imported-energy inflation and higher rates.
predictions.invalidation: Hormuz restrictions are clarified as non-disruptive and Brent falls.

predictions.mechanism: Energy-cost shock and risk-off pressure European large caps.
predictions.invalidation: Shipping remains normal and oil gives back the risk premium.

predictions.mechanism: Geopolitical escalation can increase safe-haven demand.
predictions.invalidation: Dollar/yields dominate and gold continues to sell off despite escalation.
